body.name: The Moon
body.description: Close, well-lit and gentle. Titanium in the maria, ice in shadowed polar craters.

parts.name: Scout Frame
parts.description: Light aluminium frame. Two module slots, modest armour, 10-unit sample bin.

parts.name: Field Lab
parts.description: Mid-size science platform with three module slots and a 16-unit bin.

parts.name: Hauler
parts.description: Heavy mining chassis. Four slots, thick plating, 30-unit bin.

parts.name: Rigid Wheels
parts.description: Simple machined wheels. Fast on flats, poor climbers.

parts.name: Rocker-Bogie
parts.description: The classic. Steady over rocks, climbs single-voxel steps with ease.

parts.name: Treaded Tracks
parts.description: Slow but nearly unstoppable. Best grip, best climb.

parts.name: Solar Wing S
parts.description: Folding photovoltaic wing. Great in sunlight, useless at night.

parts.name: Solar Array XL
parts.description: Twin high-efficiency arrays for power-hungry builds.

parts.name: RTG Core
parts.description: Radioisotope generator. Steady trickle day and night, anywhere.

parts.name: Li-Cell Pack
parts.description: Basic 60 unit battery pack.

parts.name: Stacked Cells
parts.description: A 120 unit stack with better cold tolerance.

parts.name: Power Vault
parts.description: 220 units of deep storage for long nights.

parts.name: Sample Scoop
parts.description: Digs soft surface material. Struggles with hard rock.

parts.name: Percussive Drill
parts.description: Chews through rock and ore at a fair energy price.

parts.name: Ablation Laser
parts.description: Vaporises anything, fast — if you can feed it.

parts.name: NavCam
parts.description: Utility camera. Enough to document what you find.

parts.name: PanoCam
parts.description: Wide sensor with colour calibration targets.

parts.name: ChemCam Pro
parts.description: Publication-grade imaging. Discoveries score highest with it.

parts.name: Proximity Sounder
parts.description: Pings anomalies within 10 tiles.

parts.name: Deep Radar
parts.description: Long-range sweep, 22 tile radius.

parts.name: Sample Crate
parts.description: Holds 20 units of mined material.

parts.name: Bulk Hold
parts.description: Holds 60 units. Heavy when full — plan your power.

parts.name: Aux Fuel Tank
parts.description: 40 units of lander fuel. More reach, more targets.

parts.name: Long-Haul Tank
parts.description: 100 units of fuel for the far destinations.

solar-array.name: Solar Array
solar-array.description: Fixed panel farm. Recharges the rover quickly within 4 tiles (daylight only).

beacon.name: Nav Beacon
beacon.description: Marks a site on the map and lights the area at night.

drill-rig.name: Auto-Drill Rig
drill-rig.description: Slowly mines the column beneath it. Drive adjacent to collect its buffer.

cache.name: Supply Cache
cache.description: Deposit cargo here to bank it as mission yield and free up the hold.

refinery.name: Refinery
refinery.description: Furnace module. Unlocks alloy smelting when the rover is parked beside it.

habitat-frame.name: Habitat Frame
habitat-frame.description: The first bones of a permanent outpost, raised from refined materials.

habitat.name: Habitat
habitat.description: A finished pressurised outpost. Recharges and slowly repairs a rover parked alongside it.

launch-pad.name: Launch Pad
launch-pad.description: Fuelled gantry. Park beside it and fire the hold home — or let it auto-ship a neighbouring drill line. Refuels between launches.

generator.name: Generator
generator.description: Radioisotope plant. Powers nearby structures day and night — the backbone of an outpost grid.

pylon.name: Power Pylon
pylon.description: Relays power onward, extending the grid to distant drills and pads.

recipes.name: Iron plate
recipes.description: Press raw iron into structural stock for advanced construction.

recipes.name: Glass
recipes.description: Fuse silica sand into panes.

recipes.name: Water
recipes.description: Melt and filter surface ice. Valuable cargo everywhere.

recipes.name: Ti-alloy
recipes.description: Furnace-grade titanium alloy. Requires an adjacent refinery.
